design_philosophy.core: Bloomberg Terminal energy meets modern EdTech. High density, tactical clarity, zero fluff, sharp typography, deep charcoal/obsidian surfaces with emerald green and gold ticker accents.
anti_patterns_avoided: No purple gradients or standard SaaS blue
No generic soft light cards with grey borders
No full-screen dark blankets overlaying illegible text
No native select elements or transparent headers without blur background

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight uppercase

layout_and_spacing.bento_grid_rules: High density grid. Sidebar list with active lesson player + tabbed notes/resources.

header.style: Sticky top bar with backdrop-blur-md bg-[#0A0D14]/90 border-b border-[#232D42] z-40
elements: Brand Logo with glowing candlestick icon
Live Market Ticker ribbon (NIFTY/S&P/NASDAQ simulation bar)
Live Session Status indicator with pulsing red badge when LIVE
Navigation Tabs (Modules, Live Session, Trading Calculators, Admin)
Student Profile badge with fast Logout trigger

whatsapp_floating_button.style: bg-[#25D366] text-black hover:bg-[#20bd5a] font-semibold px-4 py-3 rounded-full shadow-lg shadow-emerald-900/40 flex items-center gap-2 transition-transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer

login_card.style: bg-[#111622] border border-[#232D42] p-8 rounded-lg shadow-2xl relative overflow-hidden backdrop-blur-sm
elements: Tactical terminal header with glow border
Toggle tab between Student Portal & Admin Console
Pre-filled quick demo accounts helper badges for easy access testing

course_player.style: bg-[#0A0D14] border border-[#232D42] rounded-lg p-4 space-y-4
course_player.video_aspect: aspect-video rounded border border-[#232D42] overflow-hidden bg-black relative

admin_panel.style: Tabbed management matrix with dark table grid, instant localStorage persistence, modal dialogs for adding students, editing YouTube video embeds, and updating YouTube Live URL

testing_and_data_ids.rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: No sign-up option in public flow as requested. Admin manages student credentials in client localStorage.
Static site architecture compatible with GitHub Pages deployment (no backend API dependency).
Default student and admin accounts initialized in localStorage on first load for zero-friction evaluation.
All video embeds and live session links use standard YouTube embed iframe format with regex sanitizer for short/full YouTube URLs.
Persistent WhatsApp Floating Button present on every view with pre-filled message support.
Rich dark financial terminal look: glowing status badges, live market ticker ribbon, lesson progress tracking, and position size calculator helper widget.
